        """
        Persist an empty table to the database.
        
        This method is used when a table is created with persist_empty=True
        to ensure the table is stored in the database even when no operations
        have been performed on it.

        tables = self._storage.read()
        
        if tables is None:
            # The database is empty, initialize it
            tables = {}

        if self.name not in tables:

            self._storage.write(tables)

        Otherwise, the previously created table instance will be returned.

        All further options besides the name are passed to the table class which

        """

        table = self.table_class(self.storage, name, **kwargs)

        """

        # Check if persist_empty is True and handle it specially
        persist_empty = kwargs.get('persist_empty', False)

        if name in self._tables:
            # If the table already exists in memory but persist_empty is True,

            if persist_empty:
                self._tables[name]._persist_empty_table()
            return self._tables[name]
